name: Bongo one-shots (menegass)
attribution: Bongo samples by menegass (freesound.org), CC0 - credit not required
notes: Six single bongo hits from one uploader: open (high, bright), mid and low open tones, short hi/lo strokes used as tip/heel. Old (2010) recordings, single hits only, so it can sound mechanical; tap = the lowest open tone. Cut from HQ preview MP3s.
